segments.text: Hello, Daro. Sela from Qivra Works. Is now a good time to discuss LumaBoard for ten minutes?
Yes. Our handoffs sit in separate sheets, so owners and next steps are often missed.
How often does that delay follow-up, and what would make the process easier?
Several times a week. One shared view with clear owners and due dates would help.
LumaBoard tracks each handoff. For eight seats, it costs one hundred eighty credits monthly.
That is above our one hundred twenty budget. Can our current sheets move across?
We can map your columns in a sample first. I can send the layout today.
Good. Send it, and let's review the mapping next Tuesday with my colleague.
Agreed. I'll send a sample and a short calendar hold today. Thanks, Daro.
